[[Camille]] (daughter) |trainer=no |game=no |gender=Female |colors=yes |hair=White |eyes=Blue |anime=yes |epnum=JN015 |epname=A Snow Day for Searching! |enva=Danielle McRae |java=Kiri Yoshizawa |}} '''Halta''' (Japanese: '''トメ''' ''Tome'') is a recurring character who first appeared in ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]''. She is the grandmother of [[Goh]], the mother of [[Camille]], and the mother-in-law of [[Walker]]. ==History== [[File:Halta Karaoke Trophy.png|250px|thumb|left|Halta Karaoke Tournament Trophy]] When snow caused some trouble at [[Cerise Laboratory]], requiring [[Professor Cerise]] to close it down for a few days, Goh headed home, met Halta, and introduced her to {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}}. Halta gave Goh some stew before leaving for a karaoke tournament, which she hoped to win. Halta reappeared at the end of the episode and met {{Ash}}, having won the tournament and earning herself a trophy. She was briefly mentioned in ''[[JN032|Time After Time!]]'', where Camille revealed that she was participating in another karaoke tournament and ''[[JN062|Not Too Close for Comfort!]]'', when Goh recalled his lonely childhood. She reappeared in ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', when she joined a party taking place at [[Cerise Laboratory]]. During the party, Halta sang to some of Goh's Pokémon. ==Character== Halta is shown as a very outgoing and fun person.
